input.body:
## Step to reproduce
1. Create a thought and add text
2. Tap Note button and add a note
3. Create a subthought and add different text for easy spotting
4. Add a different Note to the subthought
5. Tap Swap Parent button on the toolbar

## Current behavior
Parent text is swapped accordingly.
Parent's note is gone
Children's note remains

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/da780a5d-6fdf-4bbe-9b32-da4ed035d5a1

## Expected behavior
Parent's Note should not be deleted.

As discussed with @raineorshine , we keep the note position as is, only swap the thought and subthought texts.
input.title: Swap Parent: Parent's note disappears when swapped with subthought with note
